preconditions.description: The input is a non-empty string.
The input string consists only of digits.
The length of the input string does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(stdout, str) and '+' in stdout and '=' in stdout
postconditions.description: The output is a string containing exactly one '+' and one '='.
The '+' character appears before the '=' character.
Removing '+' and '=' from the output yields the original input string.
The three parts (a, b, c) are non-empty.

postconditions.expression: not (len(stdout.split('+')[0]) > 1 and stdout.split('+')[0][0] == '0') and not (len(stdout.split('+')[1].split('=')[0]) > 1 and stdout.split('+')[1].split('=')[0][0] == '0') and not (len(stdout.split('=')[1]) > 1 and stdout.split('=')[1][0] == '0')
postconditions.description: None of the three parts have leading zeros (unless the part is exactly '0').
The equation a + b = c holds true for the parsed integers.
